item.title: Valterra Platinum’s Unki mine completes first-ever IRMA renewal audit
item.description: Nonprofit organisation (NPO) the Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA) has released the first renewal audit report in its history, assessing JSE-listed Valterra Platinum’s Unki mine, in Zimbabwe, against the IRMA standard for responsible mining. Unki’s IRMA 75 achievement level means that SCS Global Services evaluated its performance against the IRMA Standard’s 428 requirements and determined it substantially or completely met all 40 critical requirements and scored at least 75% in each of the standard’s four principle areas. (via Australasia Global Mining News) #Zimbabwe #ZimbabweNews
item.dc:creator: Australasia Global Mining News
